title: NYSci Design Make Play
text: For the New York Hall of Science, I contributed JavaScript development to the Design Make Play website. The initiative explored designing, making, and playing as approaches to STEM learning. Its website introduced those ideas through case studies and profiles of innovators, with material aimed at people working in education. Visitors could move from an overview of the approach to examples of it in practice. The project extended NYSCI’s educational work onto the web, giving the initiative a dedicated place for sharing its ideas and examples.
summary: I contributed JavaScript development to NYSCI’s Design Make Play website, presenting its approach to STEM learning through case studies and resources for educators.
